title: Interfaces for cyclic sheet geometry and coefficient hearts
statement: For the finite-field and coefficient data of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-constructible-heart], and [def-zl-constant-extension-cyclic-sheet], define the unchanged concrete interfaces ZlSheetTensorSplitting, ZlSheetGeometry, ZlSheetEquivalence, ZlSheetFiniteStage, ZlSheetCoefficientStage, ZlSheetScalarCompatibility, ZlSheetCoefficientClauses, ZlSheetHeartMap, ZlSheetCommonClauses, ZlSheetWeilCoordinates, and the canonical sheet, positive-composition, standard-class and cycle functors. They retain all actual coefficient categories, full-subcategory arrows and integral-normalized comparison maps. This is the interface-only extraction of the declarations formerly preceding constantExtensionSheetHeartCoordinates; no data or assertion is changed.

proof_origin.place: Literal extraction of the already reviewed concrete sheet/heart interfaces; no mathematical change.

source.place: (1.1.7) and paragraph after (1.1.10), pp.150–152; geometric splitting, coefficient enhancement and transition-arrow coordinates (returned steps 1–2 and coordinate part of step 3).
